svg.title: Prometheus — valley layout (top-down, metres)
svg.desc: Placement contract for the world build. Y-up world, +X east (right), -Z north (up). Camp at origin. Grid every 10 m (main map) and 1 m (camp inset). data-x / data-z attributes on markers carry exact world coordinates.
svg.text: Top-down, real scale. Camp at origin (0, 0). +X east (right) · −Z north (up) · Y is up in the world. All coordinates are (x, z) in metres. Grid = 10 m. Walkable ≈ 70 × 79 m.

g.text: fire ring 6 m · sentry reach 12 m

svg.text: 1 grid = 1 m · props at true footprint & yaw (from the current build)
(x, z) metres · y = ground unless noted
enter from tree walls / flanks at night
Positions outside the camp are Phase-2 proposals: clusters may shift ±2 m during the
world build, but place anchors (camp, grove, meadow, outpost, Spire) hold.
Open: "herb" is a cooking input with no world node in the spec — assign one in Phase 3.
